summary.name: Deep Dream Generator
summary.one_liner: Deep Dream Generator is a web-based AI art platform and community for creating images and videos from text prompts, image transformations, and 30+ AI models.
use_cases: Generating AI art from text prompts
Transforming existing photos into artistic images
Animating still images into short AI videos
Comparing outputs across different AI image models
Sharing AI artwork in a community
summary.what_it_does: The site offers text-to-image generation, transformation of uploaded images, and AI video creation, including animating static images. It provides access to more than 30 AI models for images and video, naming NanoBanana, SeeDream, Flux, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Ideogram, Veo 3, Kling and Sora 2. Free users can generate images without signing up and receive energy for generations, while subscription plans unlock more generations and advanced features. The page also hosts a community gallery of user works, artist interviews and tutorials on prompts and models.
notable: Usable without signup, with free energy for generations
Access to 30+ AI image and video models in one place
Outputs stated to be without watermarks and downloadable for commercial use
Community of AI artists with gallery and interviews, operating since 2015
caveats: More generations and advanced features require paid subscription plans
Free usage is limited by the energy allotment, with amounts not stated on the page
